nodes.name: workstationIssueAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Defines repo-scoped Jotai atoms for the workstation's GitHub issue list state, the currently selected issue's detail/comments, and a callback container for issue actions triggered from the PinnedActionsBar or issue-detail tab.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses jotai-family atomFamily keyed by a repo scope string, with a default-scope singleton derived by calling the family with DEFAULT_WORKSTATION_REPO_SCOPE, so multiple repos can hold independent issue state simultaneously.

nodes.name: workstationPrAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Defines repo-scoped Jotai atoms tracking pull-request creation readiness, the latest Source Control commit message, open/closed PR lists with their load states and errors, and a callback container for triggering PR creation and list refreshes.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports 20 members built almost entirely from repeated atomFamily(scopeKey => atom(...)) factories with debugLabel assignments for devtools, plus the workstationRepoScopeKey helper that derives the scope string from repo id/path.

nodes.name: workstationSelectedPrAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Defines Jotai atoms for the open PR detail view (identity, conversation, reviews, review comments, commits, files, checks), its active sub-tab, and a callback container for commenting/reviewing, keyed per repo and PR number so multiple PR tabs stay independent.

nodes.name: workstationRepoScopeKey
nodes.summary: Builds a stable per-repo scope key for atomFamily lookups, preferring a trimmed repo id, then a trimmed repo path, then falling back to the default workstation scope.

nodes.name: workstationPrScopeKey
nodes.summary: Builds a scope key for per-PR-detail atoms by combining the repo scope key with the PR number, so each open PR tab keeps independent state.
